# Vendored official ECCO tutorial helpers

## `ecco_po_tutorials.py`

This is the **official** ECCO v4 Python Tutorial helper module, vendored verbatim so our
skills can use it as a **Rung-1 verification reference** (see `docs/verify.md`) — i.e. we
check our own calculations against the tutorial authors' own code.

- **Source:** https://github.com/ECCO-GROUP/ECCO-v4-Python-Tutorial
- **Path in repo:** `Intro_to_PO_Tutorials/ecco_po_tutorials.py`
- **Branch:** `master`
- **Commit:** `3f0fcca17c79f622b03bf9c49ff37843191d5afe`
- **Vendored:** 2026-07-25
- **Not on PyPI / not pip-installable** — the tutorials have users download it manually,
  which is why we vendor a pinned copy rather than depend on an install.

Key functions used for verification:
- `geos_vel_compute(dens_press_filename, grid_filename, subset=None)` — reference
  geostrophic-velocity calculation (returns `u_g`, `v_g` in **model x/y** coordinates).
- `mean_weighted_binned`, `llc_grid_idx_along_lat`, `data_along_lat`,
  `depth_two_subplots`, `plot_mask` — transect/plotting helpers used by the PO tutorials.

**Do not edit this file.** It is a pinned upstream reference; our code is verified
*against* it, not the other way around. To update, re-fetch from the pinned repo and bump
the commit hash above.
